art_direction: Editorial photography, sage green, warm ivory, natural wood, restrained earthy gold, soft daylight, no text or logos.

assets.prompt: Open blank linen notebook and pen
A winding small stone path through a lush sage-green garden with young plants, leading toward gentle sunrise, metaphor for gradual progress. No grand palace, no people.
An open unlettered book on a carved wooden reading stand, beside an olive branch and a ceramic cup, soft window light. Blank indistinct pages with absolutely no readable writing.

Two inviting sage linen armchairs angled toward each other in a calm warm study, small round table with an open blank notebook between them, gentle sunlight, suggesting thoughtful conversation. No people.
Edited to show a white person's fair hands and a mixed-race person's medium tan hands supporting the seedling together.

An elegant oval mirror with natural oak frame on an ivory wall, one sprig of leaves in a small ceramic vase, quiet space for personal reflection. Mirror reflects only light and a plain wall, no people.

Three refined cream linen-bound unlettered books of different thicknesses, softly staggered on natural wood beside a small plant. Suggest learning programmes, premium restrained still life, not money.
A simple small matte brass padlock securely closed on a cream linen journal, an olive branch beside it, warm daylight, privacy and protection. Not a bank vault.
A welcoming open sage-green wooden garden gate with a sunlit path and small young plants beyond, beginning a personal journey. Eye-level, no people, no buildings.
A neatly arranged mechanical hourglass with pale sand, a simple unnumbered round clock and a small olive twig on an ivory desk, personal rhythm and preferences. No readable clock numbers.
A neat wooden desk with organised blank ivory index cards in a shallow wooden tray, a closed sage notebook, a small seedling, calm orderly workspace. No screens, no numbers, no people.
A small young plant growing beside a gently curving stone garden path after light rain, soft morning sunlight, a clear quiet route ahead suggesting starting again, no people.
